fixes.title: Orca sessions with the Orca app from the DMG
fixes.detail: Spyhop now finds the Orca CLI inside Orca.app, so sessions in Orca show up even when the CLI is not registered. If Orca still cannot be reached, those sessions appear as regular terminal cards instead of disappearing.

fixes.title: What's new appears once
fixes.detail: This window counts as seen as soon as it opens, so it does not come back on the next launch if you quit Spyhop without closing it.
